content.short: Coinbase Ventures provides a VC fund dedicated to exceptional founders and increasing global economic freedom.
content.description: Coinbase Ventures backs exceptional entrepreneurs to strengthen the crypto/Web3 ecosystem and advance the mission of increasing global economic freedom. From inception, they collaborate with founding teams and invest across all sectors of the crypto economy. Their portfolio spans hundreds of projects across layer 1 protocols, Web3 infrastructure, centralized on-ramps, DeFi, NFTs, metaverse technologies, and developer tooling, reflecting broad involvement across core crypto sectors and related technologies.
